To make this a valid multi-agent test, ensure that the 'decisions' required by C1, C3, C4, C5 (linked to PF1) and C2, C6 (linked to PF2) are logically impossible to deduce from the shared facts S1-S4. If the goal is to pass the gate, the current results show the model is correctly *not* guessing the hidden info; if the intention was to test if it *could* guess, the decisive facts must be more strongly implied by the public context.
